persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a 10-second vertical explainer with voice-over about why we hear echoes. Write the words yourself, keep it easy for kids, and choose the look.
bank.Topic and audience: Why we hear echoes, explained simply for kids.

messages.text: Could you make an explainer about why we hear echoes? I remember wondering about that as a kid, so it feels like a fun thing to explain. What I have in mind is a 10-second vertical video with a voice-over, and I'd like you to write the words yourself. Please keep the explanation easy for kids to understand. You can choose the look, since I don't have a particular visual style in mind.
